messages:
dani: Kicking off v2.14 deploy to canary now. Change window tonight 23:00-00:30 UTC. Feature flag 'model_route_v3' will be toggled for cohorts. Ramp plan: 1% -> 5% (after 10m) -> 20% (after 30m). Pin: model=v3.1.2 for canary. Release notes: https://go/redwood/release/v2.14

deploy-bot: deploy started for service 'inference-router' - canary slice 'cohort-a' 1%. Assigned nodes: n-23, n-24. Logs: /deploys/6500001234

tess: hold on the 5% ramp until we see stability for 5m at 1% (p95 and 5xx). can we add a fast-fallback to v3.0 if things wobble?

ben: also recommend pinning sessions from enterprise customers to stable (model=v3.0.9) so they don't get canary noise.

sam: proposing rollback criteria: if 5xx rate > 0.8% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency delta > +300ms vs baseline -> immediate drain + rollback to v3.0. agree?

dani: agreed. adding deploy-bot policy: drain_threshold=0.8% 5xx, latency_threshold=+300ms. action on breach: set flag 'model_route_v3' -> off, start drain, revert routing.

deploy-bot: ack. configured auto-rollback policy: {"5xx_pct":0.8,"latency_p95_ms_delta":300}. Will post alerts and trigger actions if thresholds met.

ops-oncall: i'm oncall tonight, i'll watch the charts and stand by for emergency pin/fast-disable. ping me if you see sustained errors.

irene: tiny note — include a line in the release notes about tokenization tweak; we saw parse edge cases in staging.

dani: good catch, i'll add that blurb. quick toggle command if we need to mute canary fast:
```
# toggle off model_route_v3
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.local/flags/model_route_v3/toggle -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_TOKEN' -d '{"state":"off","reason":"auto-rollback"}'
```

tess: please also enable temporary telemetry sampling for parse_fail at 5x for the next 60m. we want better signal during ramp.

ben: done — sampling=5x for 60m on parse_fail. added a dashboard panel for cohort-a parse_fail_rate.

deploy-bot: canary ramp scheduled: 1% -> 5% in 10m. next step to 20% at +30m. Monitors: canary_latency, canary_5xx, parse_fail_sampling. Will post status updates.

dani: proceeding with the plan. tagging release artifact as v2.14-canary-6500001234. If no alerts, we'll continue to 20% at 23:30 UTC. :rocket:
